about_the_game:
An "Alchemy × Roguelike RPG" where apprentice alchemist Mia takes on the dungeon.

Grid-based, turn-based exploration meets a deep alchemy system where you transmute materials into powerful items—adding new layers of strategy to the traditional roguelike experience.

Ever-Changing Dungeons

  • Each time you enter, everything changes—terrain, materials, and monster placement create a new and mysterious dungeon to explore.

  • The grid-based, turn-based system lets you take your time to find the best move.

  • When you fall, items and levels obtained during that run are lost. Embrace the tension and excitement of each adventure!

The Key to Adventure: Alchemy

  • Dungeons are filled with alchemical materials—herbs, mushrooms, ores, and more!

  • Find an Alchemy Spring and seize the chance to transmute materials into powerful items. What will you create with your limited resources? Your skill as an alchemist will be put to the test.

  • Use the powerful items you’ve transmuted to push deeper into the dungeon!

  • As Mia continues to practice alchemy, she’ll gain new recipes and unlock even more powerful recipes.
    Expand your world of alchemy and create even stronger items with each attempt.

Enhancing Equipment through Alchemy

  • At the Alchemy Spring, you can also enhance your weapons and armor using materials.

  • Evolve weapons to increase attack power or reinforce armor to boost defense—nurture your favorite equipment and make it your own!

  • Enhanced equipment is never lost, even if you fall. Strengthen yourself step by step, and the path to conquering the dungeon will open before you!

Unique Monsters Await

  • Even the cutest-looking monsters shouldn’t be underestimated.
    They’ll poison you, steal your items, and put you to sleep—each with its own tricky abilities waiting to test your wits!

  • Observe their traits and discover the right way to counter them!

High-Difficulty Dungeons to Test Your Skill

  • Challenge a special dungeon where no items can be brought in.

  • Both your alchemy skills and equipment enhancements start from scratch, offering a fresh and unpredictable adventure each time.

  • Use your knowledge, judgment, and a touch of luck to overcome the ultimate trial!

short_description: Mia, an apprentice alchemist, takes on the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Featuring classic turn-based roguelike gameplay, the Alchemy system brings new layers of strategy to your adventure. Gather materials, transmute powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!
